title: Two Centenaries
description: Chinese Communist Party goals and deadlines
extract: The Two Centenaries is a Chinese Communist Party (CCP) term that refers to two 100-year anniversaries and a stated set of economic and political goals advanced by CCP general secretary Xi Jinping following the CCP's 18th National Congress held in 2012. The Chinese government describes the Two Centenaries as the basic foundation for achieving the "Chinese Dream".
